summary: Practise customer risk ratings, ownership checks and EDD case records in this five-day course. Explore the outline and enrol.
lede: Customer due diligence training helps CDD analysts, onboarding specialists and financial crime compliance professionals verify customer information and document risk decisions. Through case exercises, participants assess customer risk, trace beneficial ownership and review politically exposed person or screening matches. They also plan source-of-funds enquiries, decide when enhanced due diligence is warranted and record escalation rationales using FATF guidance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, verify, assess or oversee customer information and need to support consistent CDD and EDD decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with customer onboarding, KYC or AML/CFT controls is recommended. No coding or specialist software is required; exercises use case materials and structured templates.
